contracts.clause_text: Section 4.1 (Service Level Agreement): Acme Cloud Services guarantees 99.95% monthly infrastructure availability. If monthly uptime drops between 99.0% and 99.94%, the customer is entitled to a 10% service credit. If uptime drops below 99.0%, a 25% credit applies to that monthly billing cycle. Service credits must be applied within 60 days of claim approval.

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Acme Cloud Services' total cumulative liability under this agreement is strictly capped at $1,500,000 USD or the fees paid by customer in the preceding twelve (12) months, whichever is greater.

Section 3.3 (Payment Terms): Invoices are issued on the first business day of each calendar quarter. Payment terms are Net-30 from invoice receipt date. Undisputed overdue amounts accrue interest at 1.0% per month or the legal statutory maximum.

contracts.clause_text: Section 2.4 (Maximum Contract Value & Spend Cap): The total aggregate billable amount under Master Services Agreement MSA-2024-APX shall not exceed $500,000 USD without prior written amendment signed by the Enterprise Chief Procurement Officer. Any purchase order issued exceeding this cap is non-binding.

Section 5.3 (Milestone Delays & Penalties): If milestone deliverables are delayed past the scheduled completion date due solely to vendor fault, Apex IT Solutions will incur a liquidated damages penalty of 1% of the milestone PO value per business day, capped at 15% total milestone value.
Section 4.1 (Invoicing & Terms): Invoices must accompany verified timesheets and signed acceptance certificates. Approved invoices will be paid Net-45 days.

contracts.clause_text: Schedule B, Clause 3 (Fuel Surcharge Restriction): Fuel surcharges may only be levied when national diesel benchmark exceeds $4.50/gallon, and the maximum allowed fuel surcharge is strictly capped at 5.0% of freight base rate. Surcharges above 5% require formal procurement approval.

Section 6.2 (Delivery Timeliness SLA): Beta Logistics guarantees 98.0% on-time delivery across all dispatch lanes. For shipments delayed by more than 48 hours without force majeure notification, a penalty of $2,000 per delayed consignment will be deducted from outstanding payables.
